card.name: Inside HIV antiviral drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through names of HIV antiretroviral drugs, such as the 'ov' in zidovudine, 'av' in ritonavir, 'ir' in rilpivirine and 'tro' in antiretroviral. It is strongest in drug-interaction lists.
